name: Spore icon
description: UI slot icon for Spore, the cache dropper. Composes `ss.proj.mine` itself via `use` — the cache the icon promises is the cache the ground shows — replacing the old hand-drawn i_mine (grey disc, red core). Rim keeps that original's red: the slot color the HUD taught players to read as 'trap'.

evolved.description: Gold-rimmed evolved twin (the old i_mine_evo), derived rather than drawn again.
